# Overview

We here use data from healthy antrum Infinium EPIC arrays or the WGBS atlas epithelial samples to classify CpG sites into three classes - biallelically methylated (mm), biallelically unmethylated (uu) and hemimethylated (um) sites. 

```{r}
m <- table(cpg_class_def$Antrum_EPIC, cpg_class_def$Gastric.antrum_WGS, dnn=c("EPIC","WGS"))
m
prop.table(m) |> round(digits = 3)
prop.table(m) |> pheatmap::pheatmap(main = "Antrum EPIC (rows) vs. WGBS Antrum CpG classes")

table(cpg_class_def$Antrum_EPIC==cpg_class_def$Gastric.antrum_WGS, dnn="Concordance") |> prop.table()

```



# IM DM results

See DGE_Result_Overview.html for definitions of hyper/hypomethylated CpG cutoff values.


```{r}
load(file.path(data_storage_folder, "Methylation_DM_lists.Rdata"))
```

## Hyper-CpGs

```{r}
sapply(all_hyper_cpg, nrow)
```
## Hypo-CpGs

```{r}
sapply(all_hypo_cpg, nrow)
```

```{r}
dm_to_methylation_class <- function(comp_name) {
  
  tmp <- rbind(all_hyper_cpg[[comp_name]], all_hypo_cpg[[comp_name]])
  tmp$direction_im <- ifelse(tmp$logFC > 0, "hyper","hypo")
  tmp$dge_class <- with(tmp, ifelse(logFC > 0, ifelse(logFC > 0.2, "hyper", "hyper_weak"), ifelse(logFC< -0.2, "hypo", "hypo_weak")))
  
  dm_with_meth_class <- merge(cpg_class_def, tmp, by.x="ID", by.y="Row.names", all.x=T, sort=F)
  dm_with_meth_class$dge_class <- ifelse(is.na(dm_with_meth_class$dge_class), "ns/nc", dm_with_meth_class$dge_class)
  dm_with_meth_class$direction_im <- ifelse(is.na(dm_with_meth_class$direction_im), "ns/nc", dm_with_meth_class$direction_im)
  
  return(dm_with_meth_class)
}
```



# IM vs. Non-IM, only new (EPIC) samples - EPIC antrum methylation calls


```{r}
comp = "IM_vs_nonIM"
dm_and_mc <- dm_to_methylation_class(comp)
```

```{r}
# table(dm_and_mc$Antrum_EPIC)
# table(dm_and_mc$Antrum_EPIC) |> prop.table()
table(dm_and_mc$dge_class, dm_and_mc$Antrum_EPIC, dnn=c("DGE class","Meth. state in healthy antrum (EPIC)"))
table(dm_and_mc$dge_class, dm_and_mc$Antrum_EPIC, dnn=c("DGE class","Meth. state in healthy antrum (EPIC)")) |> prop.table(margin=1)

table(dm_and_mc$dge_class, dm_and_mc$Gastric.antrum_WGS, dnn=c("DGE class","Meth. state in healthy antrum (WGBS)"))
table(dm_and_mc$dge_class, dm_and_mc$Gastric.antrum_WGS, dnn=c("DGE class","Meth. state in healthy antrum (WGBS)")) |> prop.table(margin=1)

table(dm_and_mc$dge_class, dm_and_mc$Gastric.body_WGS, dnn=c("DGE class","Meth. state in healthy corpus (WGBS)"))
table(dm_and_mc$dge_class, dm_and_mc$Gastric.body_WGS, dnn=c("DGE class","Meth. state in healthy corpus (WGBS)")) |> prop.table(margin=1)



table(dm_and_mc$dge_class, dm_and_mc$Colon.Left_WGS, dnn=c("DGE class","Meth. state in healthy Colon (desc.) (WGBS)"))
table(dm_and_mc$dge_class, dm_and_mc$Colon.Left_WGS, dnn=c("DGE class","Meth. state in healthy Colon (desc.) (WGBS)")) |> prop.table(margin=1)

```
